reference_limits: Human orthographic transcripts/manual dialogue acts; word times are automatic corpus forced alignment.
Stress pauses/continuations/fillers are explicitly uncertain timing/lexical candidates; not independent listening validation.
Other-speaker context references describe retained source time but may be inaudible on target headset. Only target lexical words are scored.
Heldout means distinct source sessions, not distinct global participants or globally independent conversations.
No listening or GUI presentation claimed by this program. Native source WAV is 16 kHz; 48 kHz output is upsampled.
